style.styleTitle: Homcom 6ft Slim Artificial Pine Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Christmas made simple, forever more. This HOMCOM pre decorated Christmas tree is a mess-free must-have addition to the season ahead. Crafted with 688 dense PE and PVC branch tips, white-painted ends, 31 pine cones and 31 red berry clusters, it showcases a skinny Christmas tree profile. Flame-retardant materials offer peace of mind, while a 3-section trunk and foldable metal base ensure easy setup and compact storage. It keeps steady and ready for celebrations. . Distinctive Slim Gracious Pine pencil shape with white-painted ends, pine cones and red berries for a festive look; . Crafted with dense PE and PVC branch tips to create a realistic Christmas tree with natural charm; . Sectional trunk breaks down effortlessly to make storing your Christmas tree compact and easy; . Flame-retardant branch tips offer added safety against accidental fire risks; . Metal base provides stable support and convenient space-saving storage; . Pencil shape doesn t take up much floor space, suitable for small rooms, entryways and corners; . Colour: Green, White, Red; . Material: PE, PVC, Steel; . Overall Dimensions: F63 x 180H cm; . Base Dimensions: F50 x 15H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 688; . Decoration Count: 31 x Pine Cones, 31 x Red Berry Clusters; . Item Label: 83C-253V01GN; . Note: Approx. 20-40 minutes of manual branch tip shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
